title: zebra overlay and linear dng export

commit.merge_subject: merge: zebra overlay and linear dng export

description:
Second export contract beside the raw-mosaic CFA DNG: a
demosaiced, scene-referred Linear DNG (PhotometricInterpretation
34892 LinearRaw, SamplesPerPixel=3, CFAPlaneColor 0/1/2, CFALayout,
black/white metadata reset for the developed state).

The linear develop path bakes exactly these stages into the pixels:
stages = black/white normalization (frame-preferred levels), bilinear
demosaic, as-shot white balance (divide by AsShotNeutral); no shading,
no highlight reconstruction, no camera-to-Rec.709, no tone controls,
no LUT, no denoise. developed by developLinear. The exact stage list
is recorded in the file's ImageDescription tag (270) so the reader of
the exported file knows which processing was applied. Viewing tone
mapping and linear data output stay separate paths: grading belongs to
the reader of the exported file.
